### qar\_video\_sender\_create() {#ga8b6ebd5659542d641c593be8c81745a6}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Create a producer-owned logical video stream.</p>


<p>Unlike QarRenderSender, which answers a receiver-driven render request and supplies per-frame tracking data for stereoscopic rendering, QarVideoSender owns a library-generated StreamId and may exist before any receiver connects. Its caller supplies an arbitrary video layout, begins a cycle only when at least one destination is ready, writes the sender-owned frame, and shows it without render poses, FOVs, or presentation metadata. Use QarRenderSender for remote-rendering frames requested by a particular consumer; use QarVideoSender for application-owned video such as GUI panel content.</p>


<p>Select CPU, D3D11, OpenGL, or Vulkan ingress through <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarvideosenderinit/#a0287ff06252814eb3f301e22f4e401cd">QarVideoSenderInit::graphics_api</a> and attach the matching stream-parameter extension when external graphics objects are required. Call <a href="#ga36d84c1cbe1e39cead8aa115a1b09350">qar_video_sender_stream_id()</a> to publish the generated identity.</p>


<p>Definition at line <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/include/qar-streaming-h/#l03193">3193</a> of file <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/include/qar-streaming-h">qar_streaming.h</a>.</p>

</div>
</div>
